accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 — conditional EXT-ID completeness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Completeness is asserted only after the named three-node witness, exhaustive three-node audit, and universal margin-anchored hedge have been discharged.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: EXT-ID is sound and complete conditional on those three independently stated premises; the field-level focal contribution remains the universal exact-fiber hedge.
